description_en: Modifies the remarks of a specified instance
description_zh: 调用ModifyInstanceRemark修改指定实例的备注信息
kebab_example: aliyun ddoscoo modify-instance-remark --source-ip 1.1.1.1 --instance-id ddoscoo-cn-XXXXX --remark '测试备注名1' --api-version 2017-12-28 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyInstanceRemark

parameters.help_en: The source IP address of the request. You do not need to specify this parameter. The system automatically obtains the value
parameters.help_zh: 请求源IP。无需填写，系统自动获取
parameters.name: source_ip

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can modify the remarks of only one instance in a single request
parameters.help_zh: 要操作的实例ID。单次请求只支持修改一个实例的备注信息
parameters.name: instance_id
